project_type: Python FastAPI backend for autonomous AI company operating system
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (asyncio_mode='auto'), tests in tests/ directory
test_command: eval "$(pyenv init -)" && cd /projects/sandbox/NVLabsCompany && python -m pytest tests/ -x -q
verification_instructions: 1. Run full test suite with pytest to confirm no regressions. 2. Verify new test files pass independently.
setup_instructions: eval "$(pyenv init -)" to activate Python 3.12.13; pip install -e '.[dev]' for dev dependencies
environment_constraints: Python 3.12 available via pyenv (pyenv init needed). OPEN_INTERNET mode. No Docker needed. Dashboard (frontend) must NOT be touched.
contribution_requirements: ruff lint (line-length=100), type hints everywhere, docstrings on all public classes/methods, Python 3.12 features (type | syntax), asyncio_mode='auto' for pytest-asyncio
key_patterns: LLM integration uses llm_callable: Callable[[str], Awaitable[str]] pattern (see llm_planner.py, llm_critic.py, llm_extract.py). Tests use unittest.mock.AsyncMock for LLM mocking. Atomic file writes use temp + os.replace pattern. Existing test file naming: tests/test_<module>.py. Classes use dataclass or pydantic BaseModel.
directory_structure: src/nexus/ - main source (adapters/, api/, communication/, company/, governance/, memory/, orchestration/, runtime/, etc.); tests/ - all test files flat; dashboard/ - frontend (DO NOT TOUCH)
